feature: Memories Room completed-page lifecycle, durable saves and revision-scoped unread

authorization.implementation: User approved the proposed Memories redesign
authorization.timezone: Keep the existing shared calendar timezone, fixed per page/book boundary
authorization.production: User approved migration 268 and API deployment after verification

domainGate.note: Includes journal, outbox, UI and notification-layer contracts; not the entire retired feature suite.

native.build: production/minified JavaScript + Hermes in isolated Release host
native.fixtures: Network, identity, storage and avatar boundaries; no production-user writes
checks: four-line ellipsis with original full text
immediate Save projection despite five-second simulated server delay

contracts.complete: Both authenticated authors must save valid nonempty answers
contracts.rollover: Next natural midnight in frozen shared timezone; one next page, never skipped empty pages
contracts.save: Durable local intent before optimistic projection; immutable receipt retries; explicit conflict recovery
contracts.unread: Page/answer revision ready before reminder; History entry dismissal is not row read; exact sub-millisecond revisions remain distinct
contracts.preparationBudget: At most four missing pages per batch, concurrency two, yield between reads
contracts.compatibility: Old clients keep date cursors and their original notification shape; X-Burrow-Journal: 2 gates new metadata. New client uses UUID cursors; both read the opted-in pair current page.

limitations: Client changes require the next App release; backend deployment does not replace installed client UI.
The reported occasional full native freeze was not deterministically reproduced. Confirmed editor/back traps were removed; do not claim every possible native freeze has one proven cause.
Same-page duplicate submissions wait for the first saved intent to reconcile; drafts remain retained.
Android native, physical devices, production two-user write flows and formal frame-time distributions were not verified in this task.
No all-device zero-dropped-frame or all-retired-tests claim is made.
